Neurology Care at Silver Touch Hospitals

Silver Touch Hospitals is a reliable neuro hospital in Ahmedabad, providing specialised care for stroke and movement-related neurological disorders. Our experienced team of neurologists and support staff provides patient-centred treatment with a peaceful, systematic approach, making every step less complicated for patients and families.

Stroke Care with Timely Intervention

Stroke is one of the most frequent neurological emergencies, and early intervention is vital. Our experts offer correct diagnosis, prompt medical attention, and ongoing stroke rehabilitation. We treat various forms of strokes, from clot-based (ischaemic) to bleeding (haemorrhagic) strokes, and collaborate with physiotherapy and rehabilitation professionals to aid each patient’s rehabilitation process.

Our neurologists are experienced enough to recognise signs of neurological damage at an early stage and treat cases with specialised care and attention.

Treating Movement Disorders

Diseases such as Parkinson’s disease, tremors, walking problems, or involuntary muscle spasms can affect daily life in numerous ways. Our specialists strive to minimise symptoms and enhance mobility using a mix of drugs, physiotherapy, and lifestyle modifications.

We take time to understand how each condition affects the individual, which allows us to create tailored plans that improve both comfort and independence.

Comprehensive Neurodiagnostics

Precise diagnosis is the cornerstone of successful neurological treatment. Our center provides sophisticated neuroimaging, nerve conduction tests, and EEG monitoring to identify conditions rapidly and accurately. This thorough analysis allows our neurologists to prescribe the most appropriate treatment to provide patients with timely and directed care for better recovery and long-term neurological well-being.

Smooth Coordination with Neurosurgery

When medical treatment is not sufficient, our neurologists collaborate with our in-house neurosurgeon in Ahmedabad to design and execute any necessary procedures. From a structural brain problem to a complicated spinal condition, patients are at an advantage with a combined medical-surgical treatment under one roof.

Book Your Neurology Consultation Today

Neurological signs must never be dismissed. If you or a loved one feels weakness, tremor, balance, or sudden movement changes, reach out today. Our neurology specialists are here to lead you to clarity, comfort, and the proper care.

Contact Silver Touch Hospitals or schedule your appointment today.
